target_customer: Tech and consumer companies that want to run creator ad and sponsorship campaigns without an in-house team
problem: Companies find creator marketing hard to scale because sourcing, negotiating, contracting, paying and tracking creators is manual and results are not attributable.
business_model: Managed service fee of 20% of creator ad spend or creator pay, from $15K a month

founders.name: Fernando Young
education: Harvard, sociology, cross-enrolled at MIT Sloan
founders.background_notes: Go to market at Meta, sales lead at Dare Drop, senior account executive at HubSpot per YC page.

founders.name: Jack Swisher
founders.background_notes: Co-led AI R&D at Bubble per YC page.

competitors.name: GRIN
competitors.what: Creator management software for ecommerce brands

competitors.name: Aspire
competitors.what: Creator marketplace with optional managed services

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly a services business with tracking tooling and AI assisted sourcing, built by a CTO with generative AI experience. No hard technical barrier for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Agency services are easy to copy and clients can leave monthly with no retainer. Creator relationships and negotiated rates give mild advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sign of incumbents copying or acquiring Beluga through 2026.

market_need_then: Creator spend was growing and brands wanted attributable results. The company reports clients such as Clay and sponsor results like 3,800 signups from two creators, which are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses trybeluga.ai with a try prefix, so the exact name domains were not available.

identity.voice_and_tone: Performance marketing language that compares creators to paid ads

branding.brand_signature: Beluga Files newsletter on creator economy topics
branding.community_and_virality: Publishes a newsletter called Beluga Files. No merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with a newsletter and a roster of startup clients, but name is shared with an old Beluga messaging app (shut 2011), Beluga Labs and a vodka, which dilutes search.

outcome_analysis: Beluga is a small active creator marketing agency from YC Spring 2025 with named startup clients and a high monthly minimum, and no public funding. It shows early traction claims but a services model with low defensibility and a name shared with several unrelated brands, so its path to venture scale is unproven.
notes: Searches surfaced Beluga Labs, a separate fintech for creators (with a reported $500K pre-seed in June 2025 on VCBacked). Unclear whether it is the same company as the YC listing since the YC page and a Launch page title mention Beluga Labs, so that figure is unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor sources are 2025 listicles, not launch coverage.
